author: Kevin Kelly
short: Shared settings, change history, readiness checks and configuration snapshots.
description: An optional requester-bound settings dashboard for loaded AudioPlus, CommunityPlus, LevelPlus, LogPlus, and OwoPlus cogs. Open existing setup panels, inspect health and local music prerequisites, export selected server configuration, and preview validated same-server restores while preserving member records. Includes shared theme controls, permission-aware command search, diagnostic downloads, and opt-in automatic settings snapshots with comparison and previewed restoration. Records selected server setting writes with actor, time and before/after values, bounded by count, age and bytes. Adds read-only per-feature readiness reports for configured/candidate channels, safe roles, intents and native audio prerequisites.
install_msg: Load with [p]load settingshub and open [p]settings. Maintenance requires administrator access or Manage Server. Members can use [p]commandbrowser. Use [p]settings diagnostics for a safe report or [p]snapshots for saved configuration. Enable slash commands with [p]slash enablecog settingshub, then [p]slash sync. See the README for backup scope and restoration. Reload all updated source cogs to attribute command and setup-button writes. Use [p]settings history and [p]settings ready.
end_user_data_statement: Stores server theme preferences and up to ten bounded configuration snapshots per server. Snapshots exclude member records, message histories, credentials and runtime cursors. Requester IDs and restore previews are kept in memory for up to three minutes. Files and messages posted to Discord remain managed there. Configuration history starts enabled and retains actor IDs, canonical command names, timestamps and selected old/new server setting values for 30 days by default, at most 200 records/512 KiB. Oversized values are marked previews. It excludes global credentials, personal/operational data and background attribution. User-data hooks export/delete whole retained history records identifying the user. Readiness checks change no settings.
